args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (7:00 PM)
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I hope you’re doing well. I’d like to invite you to join our book club on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library and are currently reading mystery novels.

We’d love to have you join us—please let me know if you can make it or if you’d like more details.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. If you're ever nearby, it's definitely worth stopping by.

Best regards,

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Next Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I’d like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It’s on Wednesday evening and will cover classic Italian techniques and recipes — a fun, hands-on session I think you’ll enjoy.

Please let me know if you can make it and I’ll share registration details.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Yoga Instructor Rachel
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I wanted to recommend Rachel — she’s an excellent yoga instructor who teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Her classes are well-paced, welcoming to all levels, and very effective for improving flexibility and core strength. If you’d like, I can share more details or help you get in touch with her.

Thanks,
